card.name: Digits in numbers before units
card.fires_on: A single digit inside a number, usually just before a unit such as percent, fold, g, or a thousands comma. It is strongest in quantities, rates and ranges.

modes.label: Digit before percent
modes.description: A digit within a figure that is followed by percent or %.
modes.example: the measure would raise almost four-fifths of the new revenues (78.<<8>> percent) from the top 1 percent

modes.label: Digit before a unit or fold
modes.description: A digit in an amount followed by fold, g, or a number continuing after a comma.

modes.label: Digit in a range
modes.description: A digit that starts or ends a range of values, often in dollars or distance.
modes.example: with its annual revenue between <<5>> and 7 billion dollars

card.writes: It promotes unit-like symbols such as % and x, and suppresses word endings such as fold, land and stone.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in a number when a unit like percent is likely to come next.
